items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: I played several jobs with him on the Pelican. All I remember, Ellie Begarden was playing drum with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I went to Tony's house last night, Tony Sanders here, to his barber shop. He's still cutting hair. Tried to find it when I was playing with him on the Pelican, you know. I played several jobs with him on the Pelican. All I remember, Ellie Begarden was playing drum with him.
You said, what was the Pelican? You mean that?
